WHAT WE DO / INTERIOR DESIGN

Your identity.
In every detail.

Bring layout, light, colour and materials together around the way your workplace needs to feel and function — and document it so it can be priced and built.

Let’s talk about your space ↗
Best for

Teams with a space and a brief who want it to feel and work like their own.

You leave with

A design direction, detailed drawings and a specification ready for pricing.

Pairs with

Workplace planning before it, build & fit-out after it.

DESIGN THAT CAN BE BUILT

A strong idea, carried all the way to the detail.

A workplace is judged on ordinary days, not in a single hero image. The design has to look right, and it also has to work at the desk, in the meeting room and at the pantry counter.

We develop the visual direction and the practical detail together — lighting, acoustics, storage, finishes that can be cleaned and repaired — so the design you approve is the one that gets built.

Talk to us about your project ↗
SCOPE & DELIVERABLES

From first idea to buildable detail.

The scope is agreed with you at the start, so you know exactly what is included before work begins.

01

Concept and mood direction

A small, considered set of references, colours and materials that connects the space with your brand and culture.

02

Space-by-space layouts

Furniture and settings planned for each zone, from arrival and open work areas to meeting rooms and the pantry.

03

Materials, finishes and colour

Physical samples reviewed with you, chosen for appearance, durability and how they will be maintained.

04

Lighting and acoustics

A lighting and acoustic approach for each space, coordinated with the relevant specialists and services.

05

Furniture selection

Workstations, seating, tables and storage selected or specified, with existing pieces assessed for reuse.

06

Brand and wayfinding

Graphics, signage and brand moments placed where they help people find their way and feel at home.

07

3D views of key spaces

Visualisations of the spaces that matter most, so decisions are made on what you can see.

08

Drawings and specifications

Layouts, ceiling and lighting plans, joinery details and a finishes schedule — the documents a contractor prices and builds from.

THE PROCESS

How the work moves forward.

Each stage ends with something you can review and approve before the next one starts.

  1. 01 / BRIEF

    Start from what the space must do.

    Review the planning brief, or build one with you, and confirm budget range, timing and decision-makers.

    You getA design brief and an agreed scope of design work.

  2. 02 / CONCEPT

    Set the direction.

    Present the layout approach, references and an initial material palette, then refine them with your feedback.

    You getAn approved concept to develop.

  3. 03 / DEVELOP

    Work through every space.

    Resolve furniture, lighting, acoustics, storage and finishes zone by zone, with 3D views of key areas.

    You getA developed design and a first cost check.

  4. 04 / DETAIL

    Document it for pricing and build.

    Prepare drawings, joinery details and a specification, and coordinate with services consultants where needed.

    You getA drawing and specification package ready to tender or build.

  5. 05 / SUPPORT

    Stay with the design on site.

    Answer design questions, approve samples and review installed work against the drawings during the build.

    You getDesign intent carried through to completion.

FAQS

Questions we are often asked.

Something else on your mind? Ask us directly ↗

Can you design around our brand guidelines?＋

Yes. Your guidelines inform the palette, graphics and signage, and we look for ways to express the brand through materials and light as well as logos.

Will we see the design before it is built?＋

Yes. You review layouts, material samples and 3D views of key spaces at each stage, and nothing moves forward without your approval.

How do you keep the design within budget?＋

By agreeing a budget range at the start, checking cost as the design develops, and showing where alternative materials or furniture would change the figure.

Can we reuse our existing furniture?＋

Often, yes. We assess what you have for condition and fit, and design around the pieces worth keeping.

Can we use our own contractor to build the design?＋

Yes. The drawing and specification package is prepared so any qualified contractor can price and build it. We can also deliver it ourselves through build & fit-out.

Who prepares drawings for building approvals?＋

We prepare the design drawings your building management typically asks for and coordinate with the consultants and specialists needed for services and approvals.
